Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection and began a left turn when the front of the vehicle struck the driver's
side of Driver 2's vehicle, which was proceeding straight. Driver 2 was the one who reported a wrist fracture at the
scene, and Driver 2 was seated in the vehicle when officers arrived, a fact confirmed by the responding officer and by
witnesses who saw the vehicle before and after the impact. A Passenger in Driver 1's vehicle was not injured. Two
independent witnesses on the sidewalk and the other driver each gave accounts that match the sequence of events
described here, and scene photographs show damage to the front of Driver 1's vehicle and the driver's side of Driver
2's vehicle, consistent with that impact. Officers found no sign of earlier damage to either vehicle. Driver 2 is a
member of Driver 1's household and is listed as covered under Driver 1's policy as a household member. At this time
it is not yet clear whether the reported wrist injury resulted from this collision, and the medical evaluation is pending.
</page>
